annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Assembly On-Chain State & Capability Inspector

description: Inspects live EVE Frontier Smart Assembly on-chain object metadata, owner capability ID, online power status, and attached Sui Move package digest. Use when verifying whether a Smart Turret, Smart Gate, or Smart Storage Unit is online and checking its bound Move module before interacting; for generating or auditing custom Sui Move assembly source code, use generate_eve_assembly_move instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'assembly_id' ('assembly_class' defaults to 'smart_gate'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

assembly_class.description: Smart Assembly hardware class used to validate expected capability fields; defaults to 'smart_gate' when omitted.

assembly_id.description: Hexadecimal Sui object ID or Frontier Smart Assembly identifier (e.g. '0x8f4a...c201' or 'assembly-alpha-01').

name: inspect_eve_assembly_state

assembly_id.description: Canonical Smart Assembly object identifier inspected.

attached_package_digest.description: SHA-256 bytecode digest of the custom Move extension attached to this assembly.

owner_cap_id.description: Bound Sui Move OwnerCap object ID controlling administrative permissions.
